summary_1line: Viradha abducts Sita and confronts Rama and Lakshmana, boasting of invulnerability before a fierce battle begins in the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: The demon Viradha strides through the forest clutching Sita in his arms as Rama and Lakshmana face him with drawn bows.
Rama releases a burst of golden-tipped arrows that pierce Viradha’s body, the blood-stained shafts hissing as they fall to the forest floor.
Laughing monstrously, Viradha opens his jaws and casts out the arrows lodged in him, rushing forward with a massive spear toward the two brothers.
